purpose: Teach: よせ/想う/絶好調/道端/窮屈/ハメ/等しく/踏み出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「悪口はよせ」と仰ったぞ
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, Father used to tell us: don't speak ill of others.
lines.style: Soft, remembering gaze. Slow, measured cadence. Voice carries the weight of decades. Trails gently at the end, as if still hearing his father's voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、亡き友を想う気持ちで涙を流されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa cried thinking of his departed friends, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing murmur. Gentle affection in 'dear'. Tender sadness underneath. The tone of someone who watched and understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは絶好調で働かれた
lines.en: Gran — in those days, Father worked at the height of his strength.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride softening into wistfulness. Steady breath. Slight pause before 'strength,' like he's still admiring it. Voice settles lower at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、道端のお地蔵様に手を合わせてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa used to pray before the roadside Jizo statue, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. 'Dear' carries deep affection. Thoughtful pacing. The warmth of someone recounting a beloved habit without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、戦地の窮屈な暮らしを耐えられた
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, Father endured the hardship and narrow life of the war.
lines.style: Voice drops. Quiet respect for the weight he's naming. Slow, deliberate. No rush — letting the gravity sit. Slight catch, as if this still costs something to say.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お父さんは苦労されるハメになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa's father ended up suffering so much in those days, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, aching recognition. 'Dear' reaches toward his heart. Slower than before — honoring the pain she's naming. Breath behind the words, not rushing past it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんは家族を等しく愛されたぞ
lines.en: Gran — but Father loved his family equally, with all his heart.
lines.style: Firmer now, conviction settling in. 'Equally' and 'all his heart' receive steady weight. Voice lifts slightly — pride and love breaking through the wistfulness. Still measured, but resolute.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新しい道を踏み出して下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa stepped forward onto a new path, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmth opens up. 'Dear' becomes intimate, almost a benediction. Softer, closer tone — the voice of someone who witnessed transformation. Trails off with quiet hope.
